rule: C0, the unmutated control, runs first and must be GREEN; each mutation must go RED with its own failure line; C10, a proper correction row, must stay GREEN.

failure_lines: R1-001: n=999 names no evidence entry

controls.mutation: a row's target names the wrong locus

failure_lines: R1-001: verdict 'MAYBE' is not HOLDS or FAILS

controls.mutation: a FAILS row loses its stronger line

controls.mutation: an entry ruled twice, no supersedes
